estimators.ratio: P12.5: mean over rounds of reader_mops(prev) / reader_mops(prev_locked), paired within each round, BCa 95% interval
estimators.columns: per-cell reader_mops_mean is the mean over rounds with a BCa 95% interval; reader_mops_median is auxiliary; P12.4 reads summed counters over rounds
estimators.raw: every cell carries rounds_raw, the per-round samples verbatim

ordered_readers.schedule: each round runs both probe blocks, alternating which goes first; within a block the eight (read_op, W, R) cells follow that round's row of a Williams design; one harness process per cell; the throughput pass runs every round before the counters pass
ordered_readers.soundness_gates: not evaluated by this driver: a cell read before every §12.2 gate passed on the measured head is void (§12.5)

p12_4.claim: read_fallbacks / read_ops < 0.001 in every prev cell, uniform and hotspot (METHODOLOGY.md §12.3 P12.4)
p12_4.boundary: exactly 0.1% is not below the ceiling and counts against the claim

projection.source: scripts/olc_bounds.py: ordered_projection(attempt failure of each map_read_health() cell, get_nodes in (3, 5, 7), max_ordered_read_set_branches())
projection.hypothesis: per-node independence; writes concentrated near the probe break it

p12_5.statistic: mean over rounds of reader_mops(prev) / reader_mops(prev_locked), each ratio paired within one round of the throughput build, with a BCa 95% interval (METHODOLOGY.md §12.3 P12.5)
p12_5.decision: SINGLE_RUN_PASS when the lower bound is above 1.0, REJECTED when the upper bound is below 1.0, INCONCLUSIVE otherwise; a claim needs the same verdict in two independent runs
